description: This file contains assembly code for AES-GCM encryption and decryption optimized for Apple Silicon on x86_64 architecture, generated from a Perl script in BoringSSL. It includes functions for AES-GCM encryption/decryption, CTR mode, GHASH, and related low-level cryptographic routines.

methods.name: _aesni_gcm_encrypt
methods.description: Assembly routine for AES-GCM encryption optimized for Apple Silicon on x86_64.

methods.name: _aesni_gcm_decrypt
methods.description: Assembly routine for AES-GCM decryption optimized for Apple Silicon on x86_64.
